contents.speaker: Mayor Elian
contents.text: The protective Bell has lost its Crystal Heart. Without it, the mist will swallow Dawnvale. Will you seek the Guardian?

commands.text: Quest started: The Bell of Mists

commands.speaker: Mayor Elian
commands.text: I understand. Come back when you are ready.

contents.speaker: Mayor Elian
contents.text: The Crystal Heart! Dawnvale owes you a great debt.

commands.speaker: Mayor Elian
commands.text: The bell rings once more. The mist is retreating. End of the V0 demo!

contents.speaker: Mayor Elian
contents.text: The bell protects our village once more. Thank you, hero.

contents.speaker: Mayor Elian
contents.text: The path to the east leads to the Sanctuary. Stay alert.

contents.speaker: Merchant
contents.text: The springs are dangerous. A potion restores 30 HP — today, I will give you one.

contents.speaker: Cartographer
contents.text: The path and walkway are two independent planes. Cross their junction in the center: only this explicit connection lets you change planes. Pits block an entire cell, while fences block only specific edges.

contents.speaker: Ancient Chest
contents.text: You obtain the Sanctuary Key and learn Spring Wave.

contents.speaker: Guardian's Door
contents.text: It is locked. The key must be somewhere in the Sanctuary.

contents.speaker: Gallery Watcher
contents.text: The terrace also exists above these same coordinates. While you remain in the gallery, you pass behind its surface, and the creatures there can neither see nor touch you. The ramp begins just to the east.

contents.speaker: Bell Ringer
contents.text: You are now on the terrace plane: its floor is rendered beneath your feet, then your character appears in front. The parapet is an aboveActors layer, while the gallery elements remain on their own plane.
